definitions.explanation: beauty of the highest or most extraordinary degree

examples.japanese: {絶美|ぜつび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A scene of exquisite beauty spread out before us.
This painting is said to be a work of supreme beauty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絶美|ぜつび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呑|の}んだ。
examples.english: The tourists gasped at the sublimely beautiful sight of Mount Fuji bathed in the setting sun.

notes:
A literary word emphasizing that something is beautiful to the highest possible degree. The prefix {絶|ぜつ} intensifies the meaning, conveying "beyond comparison" or "supreme." Primarily used in written and formal contexts, especially when describing scenery, art, or natural phenomena.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶美|ぜつび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: exquisitely beautiful scenery
- {絶美|ぜつび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧: sublime landscape
- {絶美|ぜつび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: a work of supreme beauty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絶景|ぜっけい}→絶景：16835_zekkei⟧: spectacular view — specifically refers to scenery, much more commonly used
- ⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧: beauty — general, neutral term
- ⟦{麗|うるわ}しい→麗しい：08184_uruwashii⟧: beautiful/lovely — literary adjective for refined beauty
- {壮美|そうび}: grand beauty — emphasizes grandeur and magnificence alongside beauty
